centralDependencyQuestion: How did a stuck valve and a misread signal lead to a partial meltdown?

evidence.claim: The main chain of events leading to the partial core meltdown on Wednesday, March 28, 1979, began at 4:00:36 a.m.
The reactor continued to generate decay heat, initially equivalent to approximately 6% of the pre-trip power level.
When RCS pressure rose to 2,255 psi (155.5 bar), the pilot-operated relief valve (PORV) opened, relieving steam through piping to the reactor coolant drain tank.
Cleanup at TMI-2 started in August 1979 and officially ended in December 1993, with a total cost of about $1 billion.
